decisionServed: Which honest reason for trying Mythical Void most often leads a visitor to choose Play?

lastFunnelImprovement.finding: The mood cards explained why somebody might care, but still left the visitor to invent what their first play session should achieve.
lastFunnelImprovement.change: Give each optional mood path a concrete three-step starter mission and visible finish line, while preserving the immediate first-screen Play action.

latestFirstScreenImprovement.finding: The live route opened the game in under one second, but the main headline asked about mood before clearly saying what Mythical Void is.
latestFirstScreenImprovement.change: Lead with the alien-creature and six-realm game promise, keep the direct Play button beside it, and move the mood question into the optional choice prompt.
latestFirstScreenImprovement.headline: Hatch a strange alien creature. Save six living realms.

latestFreshStartImprovement.finding: The Play button opened the game directly, but the words 'Start in one click' hid the first-time age choice, the reliable browser Start control sat over a second drawn version of itself, and the first egg instruction sounded more technical than it needed to.
latestFreshStartImprovement.change: Tell first-time players about the age choice before they press Play, make the reliable Start control fully cover the second drawn button, and ask them simply to click or tap the egg to begin.
latestFreshStartImprovement.publicCopy: Open the game in one click. First-time players choose an age range, then begin.

latestHatchActionImprovement.finding: The visible egg instruction did not reliably receive a real browser click, and the hatching progress message used a fixed position that pushed it away from the centre on phone.
latestHatchActionImprovement.change: Place one invisible, accessible click or tap target over the same visible egg, send it through the existing hatch action, remove it as soon as hatching begins, and centre the progress message for the current screen.

promises.promise: Follow the signal into six impossible realms.

starterMission.title: Find the first impossible thing.
steps: Reach the Mythical Forest and notice what Earth's maps cannot explain
starterMission.finish: The journey no longer feels like an ordinary rescue mission.

promises.promise: See what the creature engine makes with you.

starterMission.title: Hatch a creature and begin its story.
steps: Care for the life form until it hatches
Name the creature and take it through the first gate
starterMission.finish: The creature is moving through the story beside the astronaut.

promises.promise: Recover the ship. Cross the realms. Free the guardians.

starterMission.title: Release the first guardian.
steps: Recover the ship and hatch the creature
Clear the corruption holding the Elder Treant
starterMission.finish: The first guardian is restored rather than defeated.

promises.promise: Project Beacon begins as an order and ends as your choice.

starterMission.title: Find out why the mission changes.
steps: Earn the creature's trust and enter the Mythical Forest
Continue until Project Beacon no longer feels like a simple order
starterMission.finish: Discovery and responsibility have become the same problem.

decisionRules.ifOnePromiseLeads: Use it as the first public sentence, then verify it again with a fresh period.
decisionRules.ifNoPromiseLeads: Keep the balanced doorway and improve the game proof before changing the words.
